chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about some people in a village: do they perform the Jumu'ah prayer in congregation? He said: They should pray four rak'ahs if there is no one to deliver the sermon.

key_terms.أَرْبَعًا: four rak'ahs, meaning the regular zuhr prayer form
key_terms.يَخْطُبُ: delivers the khutbah or sermon required for Jumu'ah

ai.seo_question: What should villagers do for Jumu'ah prayer if no one is available to deliver the khutbah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning people in a village regarding Jumu'ah prayer. It states that if there is no one to deliver the khutbah, they are to pray four rak'ahs instead, indicating the necessity of the sermon for the establishment of Jumu'ah.
